jobs.excerpt: Forever On!  From the start in 2008, T5 has been focused on supporting enterprise and hyperscale customers with customized data center solutions.
jobs.description:
Forever On! From the start in 2008, T5 has been focused on supporting enterprise and hyperscale customers with customized data center solutions. Today, we remain dedicated to an unmatched level of quality that extends across the lifecycle of the core data center—from customized turnkey development, facilities management, and data center operations to specialized construction solutions worldwide.

The world’s largest companies trust T5 with their data center operations.

At T5, our success is driven by our people. With hundreds of engineers, technicians, and professional staff, we foster a culture of excellence, ownership, and continuous improvement.

  • Commitment to Diversity & Military Veterans
  • Battle-Tested Leadership Experience
  • 100% Data Center Focused
  • Owner-Operator Mindset

Job Description

    The Senior Procurement Specialist – Construction enables the commercial execution of construction contracts across T5 projects by translating site-defined scope and vendor selections into structured, enforceable agreements aligned to cost, schedule, and risk objectives.

    This role partners closely with Construction and Preconstruction teams to convert project requirements into clear contractual frameworks, ensuring commercial terms, pricing structures, and risk allocation are well-defined and executable.

    Operating within a decentralized delivery model, site teams retain ownership of vendor sourcing and selection, while this role brings consistency, clarity, and discipline to the commercial and contractual components of those engagements.

    In addition to hands-on contract execution, this position strengthens site capability by providing real-time guidance, coaching, and practical support to improve scope definition, vendor comparison, and overall commercial decision-making.

Responsibilities

    • Translate awarded scopes and vendor selections into executable contracts, including scope definition, commercial terms, and contract structure
    • Lead contract negotiations to align pricing structures, risk allocation, and commercial frameworks with project requirements
    • Evaluate vendor proposals from a commercial perspective, identifying gaps in scope, pricing inconsistencies, and potential risk exposure
    • Structure agreements with clear inclusions, exclusions, cost drivers, and financial terms to support accurate project execution
    • Partner with Construction and Preconstruction teams to ensure project requirements are clearly defined and contractually aligned
    • Coordinate with Legal, Risk, and internal stakeholders to resolve commercial and contractual considerations
    • Prepare and route agreements through internal approval workflows to support timely execution
    • Provide real-time commercial guidance to site teams during vendor engagement and proposal review
    • Coach site leads on scope clarity, vendor comparison, and commercial best practices to improve decision quality
    • Promote consistent use of templates, playbooks, and standardized contracting approaches to improve efficiency and scalability
    • Identify opportunities to improve commercial outcomes, including cost structure optimization and contracting efficiency
    • Support end-to-end contract execution activities, ensuring alignment with internal systems and documentation standards

Qualifications

    • 8+ years of experience in construction procurement, preconstruction, or commercial contracting
    • Strong understanding of construction cost structures, contract frameworks, and risk allocation principles
    • Proven experience negotiating complex commercial agreements in a project-based environment
    • Experience working cross-functionally with Legal, Risk, Construction, and Operations teams
    • Ability to operate independently in a fast-paced, project-driven environment
    • Strong analytical, negotiation, and communication skills
    • Ability to influence and guide stakeholders without direct authority

Benefits

    • Medical, dental, vision
    • 401(k) with match
    • PTO and paid holidays
    • Bonus eligible
T5 Data Centers is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion.

Overview

Nurse Practitioner Per Diem

This position covers all zip codes in: Garland County, AR

ComplexCare Solutions (CCS) specializes in helping those in need by delivering high-value home and virtual assessments for health plans nationwide. We pride ourselves on our member engagement aimed towards evaluating current health status, gaps in care, potential health risks and care management opportunities with a focus on driving better clinical outcomes.

CCS, on behalf of SME Medical Delaware, P.A., is calling on Advanced Practice Providers that are passionate about helping their local communities. We care dearly about those whom we serve, and we need your help to make a difference in the lives of our members. Providers have the opportunity to spend a full hour with these members, which allows them to capture a comprehensive picture of that individual’s personal needs and what is required to keep them in the home and out of the hospital.

Compensation:

  • Pay Range: $2,400.00 - $10,000.00 per month (Potential income) Earnings will vary based on completed assessments, state of residence, and business needs as there is no guarantee of visits or minimum income
  • In-home visit rate: $120 - $140 depending on state of residence
  • If available, our telehealth rate is $85 per completed assessment

Benefit:

This position is eligible to participate in a company 401K plan providing the opportunity to save for retirement through employee contributions. New hires will be automatically enrolled in the company 401(k) plan at a 3% contribution rate with the option to opt out.

Responsibilities

  • Knowledge of CMS Regulations and NCQA HEDIS Guidelines
  • Knowledge of Evidence-based Clinical Practice Standards: American Diabetes Association (ADA), American College of Cardiology (ACC), American Heart Association (AHA), Familiarity with ICD-10 and CPT-4 coding practices
  • Complete comprehensive, accurate and thorough review of the assigned member population, including timely completion and submission of all required encounter documentation (paper or electronic)
  • Ensure that all pertinent and active medical conditions are documented in the medical record in a manner compliant with CMS/DHHS, Company policy, and client requirements
  • Support the physician/patient relationship and ensure timely and adequate communication, documentation of assessment findings, recommendations, need for additional services, emergency services required if necessary and need for follow up and timelines for follow up to primary care provider (PCP) and health plan as required
  • Make general recommendations to members intended to improve members' knowledge of their chronic condition(s), such as information concerning recommended testing
  • Address and close identified gaps in care (disease-specific or preventive)
  • Recognize emergent or urgent situations requiring escalation and take appropriate action as specified in company policies, and as determined by reasonable professional judgment and ethical professional practice standards; and
  • Perform, document and communicate results of Point of Care (POC) Testing
  • Maintain compliance with Company policies, procedures and mission statement
  • Adhere to all confidentiality and HIPAA requirements as outlined within the Company’s Operating Policies and Procedures in all ways and at all times with respect to any aspect of the data handled or services rendered in the undertaking of the position
  • Fulfill those responsibilities and/or duties that may be reasonably provided for the purpose of achieving operational and financial success of the Company
  • Uphold responsibilities relative to the separation of duties for applicable processes and procedures within your job function

  • We reserve the right to change this job description from time to time as business needs dictate and will provide notice of such
  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

  • Active un-encumbered license to practice nursing
  • ANCC or AANP board certification as a Nurse Practitioner or Clinical Nurse Specialist in Family, Adult, Gerontology or Emergency Medicine.

  • Compliance, prior to hire, with recommended Healthcare Personnel Requirements for vaccinations and preventive testing:

    • Varicella
    • Tuberculosis

  • Understanding of Medicare, Medicaid and Health Plan benefit structures beneficial
  • Ability to multitask
  • Excellent customer service skills
  • Bi-lingual or multi-lingual a plus
  • Ability to practice autonomously in a remote clinical environment, including independently conducting patient assessments, formulating evidence-based treatment plans, managing complex chronic conditions, and making sound clinical decisions without direct on-site supervision

jobs.excerpt: About UsAt Prenuvo, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive “sick-care” to proactive health care.
jobs.description:
About Us

At Prenuvo, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive “sick-care” to proactive health care. Our award-winning whole body scan is fast (under 1 hour), safe (MRI has no ionizing radiation), and non-invasive (no contrast). Our unique integrated stack of optimized hardware, software, and increasingly AI, coupled with the patient-centric experience across our domestic and global clinics, have allowed us to lead the change against “we caught it too late again".

The Manager, Software Engineering is responsible for leading and developing high-performing, cross-functional engineering teams, overseeing project execution, driving technical strategy, and aligning operations with Prenuvo's broader business objectives. In this role, you will balance technical leadership and people management to ensure your team delivers reliable, scalable, and impactful healthcare technology.

This role is responsible for delivery and integration of services centered around the Salesforce (Sales Cloud and Health Cloud) platform. This individual must apply

This role does not provide visa sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must not require employer sponsorship for a work visa (current or future).

Help reshape the world through proactive healthcare while working with cutting-edge technology and high performing teams with deep expertise - join us to make a difference in people’s lives!

What You’ll Do

  • Develop Talent and Technical Skills: Lead cross-functional engineering teams with an explicit focus on talent development. You are directly responsible for the awareness and development of essential technical skills within each team, fostering growth through regular 1:1s, ongoing mentorship, and clear career pathing.
  • Drive Agile Delivery: Own the day-to-day execution and delivery of your team. Champion agile methodologies to ensure predictable sprint cycles, high velocity, and timely project completion.
  • Provide Technical Leadership: Act as a hands-on technical mentor, guiding the team through complex architectural decisions, setting code quality standards, and participating in code reviews.
  • Align Cross-Functionally: Collaborate closely with Product, Design, Security, and Marketing teams to define the product vision, prioritize the backlog, and ensure alignment on project scope and quality.
  • Ensure Quality & Compliance: Assure that engineering processes, system architecture, and documentation meet high-quality standards and applicable healthcare regulatory guidelines (e.g., HIPAA, SOC 2).
  • Optimize Engineering Operations: Identify bottlenecks and implement process improvements to enhance software development efficiency, maintainability, and team health.
  • Track Performance: Define and monitor key performance metrics to measure team productivity, code quality, and delivery timelines, communicating progress to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What You’ll Bring

  • 8+ years of professional experience in software engineering.
  • 2+ years of direct people leadership and engineering management experience.
  • A People-First Leadership Philosophy: You have a proven ability to build and develop high-performing engineering teams through effective hiring, training, mentoring, and feedback. You don't just focus on the technical, mechanistic elements of software delivery; you prioritize developing and promoting genuine People Leaders.
  • A Culture-Driven Mindset: You intentionally cultivate a team culture that is creative, collaborative, curious, caring, and conscientious.
  • Strong technical background with demonstrated experience designing and delivering systems using: Python, React, TypeScript, Flask/FastAPI, Redux, NoSQL, and Serverless architectures.
  • Solid understanding of cloud infrastructure and Infrastructure as Code (e.g., AWS, CloudFormation, Terraform), including designing for scalability and supportability.
  • Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills, with a track record of partnering with product management to define vision and development priorities.
  • A passion for process improvement, agile methodologies, and aligning engineering efforts with the company's strategic objectives.

Our Values

First: we are Pioneers

  • Transforming healthcare requires divergent thinking, bias for action, disciplined experimentation, and consistent grit and determination to maintain momentum. This journey is as challenging as it is rewarding.

Second: we are Platform-Builders

  • We’re always building foundations that allow us to achieve tomorrow more than we did today. We never lose sight of what’s ahead – in a mindset of ownership and duty to our mission.

Above all: we are Patients

  • We could all be the next person who walks through our very doors, seeking clarity or peace of mind. We are proud of our impact on our patients’ lives, and we won’t stop till everyone can benefit from our work.

What We Offer

  • An avenue to make a positive impact on people's lives and their health
  • We believe in preventative healthcare for everyone, including our team - Prenuvo provides free, whole-body scans to each team member
  • Growth opportunities are at the heart of our people journey, we’re doing big things with bright minds - there is no single path to success, it can be shaped along the way
  • Building strong relationships is at the core of everything we do - our team gets together each week to connect, share, and socialize
  • Recognizing time away to restore is vital to our wellbeing - we have a flexible vacation policy and we will encourage you to use it
  • We now offer the Prenuvo’s Commuter Benefits Plan to help cover your transit and parking costs. Whether you ride, drive, or park, we’ve got you covered—making your commute easier and more affordable!
  • Prenuvo offers a 401(k) retirement savings plan to eligible employees, allowing team members to make pre-tax contributions toward their retirement. While Prenuvo facilitates access to the plan, the company does not currently offer matching contributions.
  • We offer a comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, vision, including Mental Health coverage, to support you and your family
  • The base salary for this role is $220,000-$240,000 in local currency, depending on experience and geographic location

We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

As part of the hiring process, successful candidates will undergo a background check in compliance to applicable federal, provincial, and state rules.

jobs.excerpt: Hiring Filipino and Philippine-based professionals only!
jobs.description:
Hiring Filipino and Philippine-based professionals only!

Wingz, is a leading US rideshare company focused on Non-Emergency Medical Transportation (NEMT).

Visit our website:

Position: Market Operations Associate

Work Schedule: US Hours (EST)

Employment Set-up: Remote (Independent Contractor)

Employment Type: Full-Time / Long Term

Salary Range: USD 950 - 1,200 / Month

Benefit: 10 PTO and HMO after the probationary period

Pay-out Frequency: Semi-monthly

Equipment: Self-Provide

Job Summary:

Market Operations keeps our markets running: enough verified drivers on the road, every trip assigned before the day begins, and every trip completed on time. You'll own a piece of that and be measured on it. This is a decision-making role, not a scripted one — you'll make calls, act, and explain your reasoning afterward. If you're looking for phone-based client support with defined procedures, our Client Support Specialist opening is the better fit.

How your responsibilities are assigned

  • The responsibilities below cover everything Market Operations does across five areas. You will not be responsible for all of them.
  • During the hiring process, we'll evaluate where your strengths fit best, and you'll start in one area. Your assignment is confirmed before you accept the offer, so you'll know exactly what you're taking on. Over time, you'll be cross-trained into more.
  • Read this as the map of the team you're joining, and your starting point within it.

Responsibilities:

If assigned to Driver Onboarding & Activation

  • Make fast first contact with new driver applicants and guide them through the application
  • Run onboarding interviews, group and 1:1, and decide who advances
  • Review driver documents for accuracy and compliance, and coach applicants through corrections
  • Coordinate background checks and screenings, and follow up until cleared
  • Run activation calls so new drivers are confident on the app before their first trip
  • Keep the roster current: expiration outreach, reactivation checks, and removing inactive drivers

If assigned to Dispatch & Scheduling

  • Build driver schedules and assign trips against them
  • Sweep the current week for schedule gaps and fill them before trips go uncovered
  • Work inside our AI-assisted dispatching tools, producing and acting on the daily output
  • Flag where the tooling gets it wrong so it improves
  • Notify drivers of schedule changes

If assigned to OTP Specialist

  • Monitor on-time performance live and intervene before a trip goes late, not after
  • Own urgent trip reassignments end to end: the decision, driver contact, and resolution
  • Keep clients informed before they have to ask
  • Step in when leads are tied up so nothing waits in a queue

If assigned to Routing Specialist

  • Build and adjust routes for efficiency and reliability
  • Make sure drivers activate GPS well ahead of pickup
  • Chase and coach drivers who don't, before it becomes a data gap
  • Protect billing and claims accuracy by keeping trip data complete

If assigned to Market Associate

  • Cover a portion of all three areas above in a newer or smaller market
  • Shift week to week toward whatever is currently limiting the market
  • Flag early which area is about to break

Every Market Operations Associate, in every area

  • Own your daily and weekly targets, and know where you stand without being asked
  • Resolve problems in your area rather than handing them off
  • Escalate what's genuinely above your authority, with what you've already tried and what you recommend
  • Keep driver and trip records accurate in every system you touch
  • Improve the procedures you work from, and document the ones that don't exist yet
  • Cross-train as backup on one adjacent area
  • Bring us patterns, not just incidents

Requirements

Required

  • 2-4 years in operations, dispatch, logistics, or program coordination, a role where you owned an outcome, not just a queue
  • Sound judgment without a script. Much of this work has no procedure for the situation in front of you
  • Comfort with tradeoffs. Some days you can cover one trip or the other, not both, and you'll need to decide quickly and defend the call
  • Comfort being measured daily. You should want the scoreboard, not avoid it
  • Ability to hold several threads at once and switch between them without dropping any
  • Strong written and verbal communication — most areas involve daily calls with drivers
  • Composure when things break. Some days are interrupt-driven and won't go as planned
  • Detail accuracy where a missed date or wrong record has real consequences
  • Strong spreadsheet skills and the ability to learn new tools quickly
  • Willingness to work ET hours, including weekend or holiday rotation depending on assignment
  • Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet space for video calls

Preferred

  • NEMT, healthcare transportation, or other regulated service experience
  • Dispatch, fleet, or last-mile operations background
  • Applicant tracking or recruiting platform experience
  • Experience running group interviews or high-volume onboarding
  • Experience with AI-assisted operational tooling

Job Description

The School of Oceanography has an outstanding opportunity for a Project Manager (program operations specialist) to join their team.

About this Opportunity

Working under the supervision of the Director of SEASAM. the SEASAM Project Manager provides administrative oversight of the Seafloor Sampling Facility, serving as a key interface between the scientific and and logistical functions of the facility. Grounded in strong scientific and professional experience with physical seafloor sampling operations, including shipboard characterization and archival, the Project Manager is the first and central point of contact for supported researchers, other facilities (including vessel operations) and vendors. The Project Manager has budget authority and oversees all purchasing for the facility including travel, consumables, maintenance, and repair of equipment. Crucially, the Project Manager leverages their experience to facilitate internal and external communication and oversee scheduling logistics, ensuring facility operations are both effective and efficient.

Key Responsibilities

Cruise Planning 30%:

Serve as the first and central point of contact for the SEASAM Facility, including for researchers preparing proposals, funded Principal Investigators (PI), vessel and other facility operators (e.g., Multidisciplinary Instrumentation in Support of Oceanography (MISO) Facility, National Deep Submergence Facility (NDSF)) that require scientific or operational support from the SEASAM Facility. Track the University-National Oceanographic Laboratory System (UNOLS) Marine Facilities Planner (MFP) to identify funded projects that may need support and initiate PI contact. Set up internal and external meetings and maintain accessible documentation of meeting outcomes. Work with Operations Manager to develop support budgets for external users of the facility and as-required for the National Science Foundation. Bring scientific and logistical expertise to operational decisions regarding equipment and personnel.

Operational and Shipping Logistics 30%:

Utilize operational and logistical expertise to represent SEASAM in UNOLS scheduling meetings as required. Maintain an updated calendar of cruise dates, mobilization and demobilization information, personnel assignments, and synopses of equipment and consumable needs. Work with Operations Manager and Expedition Leads to coordinate shipping and travel related to SEASAM Facility activities. Collate shipping quotes and handle documentation of competition when applicable. Procure over-the-side insurance for equipment as required. Navigate radiation safety use considerations and documentation for shipping of radiation sources required for shipboard operations (e.g., sealed 137Cs source, CT-scanner, portable X-ray sources). Manage shipping and travel bookings for SEASAM equipment and personnel, including return shipping of recovered samples to designated repositories.

Inventory and Consumable Management 30%:

Manage assets and records of physical inventory status and location, both internally and on the UNOLS MFP. Contribute scientific and operational expertise to decisions surrounding equipment maintenance and development priorities. Coordinate with Operations Manager and Expedition Leads in budgeting for consumables, maintenance and repair of equipment. Oversee vendor contracts, including establishment of purchase orders and invoice submissions.

Community Liaison and Workforce Development 10%: Work collaboratively with the Impact Manager, Operations Manager, and Director to facilitate community input, workforce development (PI training, sea-going interns, etc.) and discovery of facility resources and data products. Collate technician post-cruise feedback and documentation on operational experiences to build institutional knowledge of seafloor sampling operations from UNOLS and non-UNOLS platforms.

Other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

To be considered for this opportunity your application must demonstrate you meet both the minimum qualifications and additional qualifications listed below. Equivalent education and/or experience may substitute for minimum qualifications except when there are legal requirements, such as a license, certification, and/or registration.

Minimum Qualifications

Applicants who do not meet these qualifications WILL NOT be forwarded to the Hiring Manager.

· Bachelors’ degree in Earth or environmental science (e.g., marine science, geology, geography, etc.) or equivalent experience.

· Four years' experience in the broad field of marine geoscience, including:

  • Engagement with laboratory and shore-side research reliant on seafloor samples
  • Experience with seafloor sampling operations, including:

About Abridge

Abridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare. Our AI-powered platform was purpose-built for medical conversations, improving clinical documentation efficiencies while enabling clinicians to focus on what matters most—their patients.

Our enterprise-grade technology transforms patient-clinician conversations into structured clinical notes in real-time, with deep EMR integrations. Powered by Linked Evidence and our purpose-built, auditable AI, we are the only company that maps AI-generated summaries to ground truth, helping providers quickly trust and verify the output. We are a growing team of practicing MDs, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to empower people and make care make more sense. We have offices located in the Mission District in San Francisco, the SoHo neighborhood of New York, and East Liberty in Pittsburgh.

The Role

Want to work on building out security from the ground up at the leading edge of AI in healthcare globally? We're looking for a very experienced and highly motivated Staff Application Security Engineer to join our team as one of the first engineers on the Abridge Security team. In this role, you'll be a key technical leader, driving key initiatives that shape our product, infrastructure, and engineering practices. Impact both the vision and hands-on execution of our secure software development lifecycle (SDLC) across the entire product portfolio. You'll work cross-functionally with product and engineering teams to integrate security seamlessly, automate security capabilities and controls, and mentor others to build secure-by-default systems at scale in the age of AI. This position requires deep technical expertise, a builder's mindset, and excellent communication skills to influence security culture across the organization.

What You’ll Do

Secure Development & Architecture Leadership

  • Lead Threat Modeling and Design Reviews: Impact the product from ideation through to code that is shipping to production. Conduct advanced threat modeling and security architecture reviews for complex systems, new products, and platform initiatives, providing expert guidance and requirements to meet Abridge’s security goals.

  • Define Security Strategy: Define and implement the technical roadmap for the Application Security program, focusing on scalable assurance, proactive security measures, and setting clear standards and guardrails.

  • Mentor and Enable: Act as a subject matter expert and trusted advisor to product and engineering teams, providing mentorship on security features, product defense, secure coding practices, application architecture, and vulnerability remediation strategies.

  • Conduct Training & Awareness: Develop training materials for engineers to build a foundation of security best practices across the engineering organization.

Vulnerability Management & Incident Response

  • Code and Security Reviews: Perform and lead in-depth secure code reviews (both manual and tool-assisted) to identify complex security vulnerabilities and flaws, including logic and authorization vulnerabilities that automated tools often miss. Get hands on with assessing AI models, agents, and architectures.

  • Internal Penetration Testing: Lead internal penetration testing engagements for net new products and historical systems identify security risks across our environment.

  • Vulnerability Program Oversight: Design and enhance the end-to-end vulnerability management program for Abridge’s products and applications, ensuring timely identification, prioritization, and remediation of critical security issues while doing so in as developer-friendly a way as possible.

  • Security Incident Response: Serve as an expert on Abridge’s products and applications for the security incident response team, assisting in investigating and resolving security events and incidents.

What You’ll Bring

  • Experience: 10+ years of direct experience in an Application Security role, with a demonstrated history of designing and implementing security improvements at scale.

  • Programming Fluency: Deep proficiency in one or more major programming languages (Python and NextJS a big plus) and a solid background in software development principles.

  • Cloud & Containers: Extensive experience securing applications deployed in Cloud environments (GCP a big plus) and knowledge of containerization technologies (Kubernetes).

  • Security Research: Proven experience contributing to or leveraging open-source security tools, publishing security research, managing bug bounty programs, and active engagement in the security industry.

Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month.

About Us:

Spreedly is the world's leading Open Payments Platform. Founded in 2007 and headquartered in Durham, NC, the company gives mid-market and enterprise businesses the infrastructure to connect to any payment gateway, processor, or fraud tool through a single API. The platform is vendor-agnostic by design, meaning customers are never locked into a single provider and never need to rebuild their payments stack to access new capabilities.
The core business problem Spreedly solves is real and costly: global merchants face a fragmented payments ecosystem, where every new market, payment method, or fraud tool typically requires a separate, time-consuming integration. Spreedly eliminates that complexity, enabling companies to route transactions intelligently, secure cardholder data, prevent fraud, and expand into new markets without heavy engineering overhead.

Product Offering:

Spreedly provides an open payments platform. The platform’s connectivity provides payments performance. Key products and services include:

Connect — A unified API that integrates with hundreds of payment gateways, processors, and alternative payment methods worldwide, including digital wallets. Merchants access the global payments ecosystem through one connection.
Vault — A PCI-compliant secure repository for payment methods. Merchants store card data once and reuse it across any payment service, reducing PCI scope and protecting cardholder data at scale.
Optimize — Workflow-driven routing and retry logic that directs each transaction to the best-performing gateway in real time. On average, 7.9% of failed transactions succeed immediately when retried on a secondary gateway. This is where merchants recover lost revenue and increase authorization success rates.
Protect — A flexible fraud and authentication layer, incorporating advanced fraud tools and 3DS. Following Spreedly's acquisition of Dodgeball in September 2025, fraud orchestration and payment optimization now operate within the same platform.
Resolve — Centralized management and reporting that reduces operational silos, strengthens security, and improves billing control across a merchant's entire payment operation.

What It's Like to Work Here:

We describe our team as "Spreedlings": diverse, forward-thinking, and driven by a shared belief that a more open payments ecosystem benefits everyone. The company operates with a culture built on transparency, courageous collaboration, and self-driven leadership. The team values simplicity in both product and process, and approaches problem-solving with genuine curiosity.
About the Role:
The Partner Growth Manager (PGM) is responsible for driving revenue growth through Spreedly’s strategic partner ecosystem. This role focuses on strengthening relationships with Spreedly’s premier and standard partners while identifying and executing opportunities to generate new business together.
The PGM works closely with Sales to co-sell into shared prospects and customers, expand existing partner relationships, and accelerate partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue.

  • Closeout Reporting: Prepare comprehensive closeout packages and individual grant closeout reports summarizing financial status, resolved/outstanding issues, and recommendations for remediation.

The Role

Do you care deeply about secure access at scale? Making sure the right people have the right access, exactly when they need it, without slowing teams down? Join Moveworks and help shape the future of our identity and access strategy.

At Moveworks, we believe great security is an enabler, not a blocker. As a Senior Identity & Access Management Engineer, you’ll be a hands-on technical developer, coding, designing, building, and scaling IAM solutions across cloud infrastructure, SaaS applications, and internal systems. You’ll own the development of IAM initiatives end-to-end, from untangling ambiguous access challenges to architecting secure, automated solutions and driving them into production.

In this role, you’ll develop robust access models across AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, and beyond; reduce privilege sprawl through thoughtful role design; and build strong observability through logging, metrics, and reporting in our SIEM. You’ll modernize access reviews to deliver real security impact with minimal friction, continuously de-risk IAM threats, and partner closely with teams to drive adoption of secure-by-default patterns.

Your work will directly protect Moveworks’ most critical systems while enabling our engineers to move fast, safely, and confidently.

What you get to do in this role:

  • Be the technical developer to drive IAM application development: Code, design, and implement solutions with extensive knowledge in AWS, Azure, Teleport, and Terraform. Enabling robust and reliable solutions to keep our engineering teams active.

  • Drive IAM projects end-to-end: Take ambiguous access problems, understand and have the ability to define requirements, architect solutions, and own the rollout/operationalization (not just the design).

  • Develop with secure access models in mind: Continuously develop role design improvements and access assignment patterns across AWS, Kubernetes, SaaS apps, and internal systems to reduce unnecessary privileges, minimize manual grants, and create scalable “safe baseline” access that covers routine work without daily elevation.

  • Develop on operationalizing logging and metrics: Ensure access changes are observable in our Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) tool; build repeatable reporting that surfaces risky access and drift.

  • Run and improve user access reviews (UAR): Develop, execute and design a UAR process & solution that meets compliance requirements while improving real security signal—minimizing approver burden through scoping, automation, and clear decision support.

  • Develop technology to continuously de-risk: Identify high-risk permissions and misuse paths, propose appropriate controls and mitigations, drive adoption with partner teams, and develop solutions to continuously de-risk.

  • Operate with strong security judgment and high signal: Reliably distinguish meaningful IAM risk from noise, gather context efficiently, and escalate with crisp rationale and actionable mitigations.

  • Document and standardize the paved road: Write lightweight procedures, runbooks, and automation so access decisions are consistent, scalable, and not dependent on tribal knowledge.

To be successful in this role you have:

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience developing and maintaining IAM products/tools.

  • Automation-first mindset: Experience writing production-ready scalable software, Infrastructure as Code, and using AI coding tools to build reliable automation.

  • IAM Expertise: Strong grasp of IAM best practices, techniques, and common failure modes (e.g., least privilege, privilege escalation paths, separation of duties, breakglass, auditability). Ability to spot dangerous permissions and identify suitable mitigations and controls.

Join Our Team as Associate Editor at Canada’s National Observer

Reports to: Jimmy Thomson, Editor-in-Chief

Hours: Mon - Fri, 12 - 8pm Eastern Time / 9am-5pm Pacific Time

Status: Management role in a unionized workplace (this position is non-union)

About CNO

Whatbegan at a dining room tablein Vancouver in 2008 is now one of Canada's most decorated independent newsrooms.

Observer Media Group launched Vancouver Observer first, then Canada's National Observer in 2015, betting that excellent reporting and accountability journalism could thrive outside legacy media. In 2017, CNO became the first digital-only publication in Canadian history to win a National Newspaper Award and receive a Michener citation for public service journalism. "The little engine that could," then-Governor General David Johnston called it.

As we've grown, the awards have kept coming, and so has the impact. CNO investigations have forced government resignations, exposed dysfunction in the regulatory system overseeing a $15-billion pipeline, and revealed disinformation campaigns targeting local democracies. We have also shone a light on the best of Canadian innovation and solutions. In an era of climate crisis and coordinated disinformation, excellent accountability journalism has never mattered more.

Today, CNO covers Canada's changing climate from newsrooms in Vancouver, Calgary, Toronto, Montreal, and Ottawa, with more than 35,000 articles published. Last year we launched Civic Searchlight — our popular "superpower for democracy" — and earned ten new journalism award nominations this spring alone, including the inaugural Hinton Award for AI Safety Reporting from the Canadian Journalism Foundation.

The role

Canada’s National Observer seeks a talented editor with journalism and management experience to support the next phase of our award-winning journalism. You’re the right person for the job if you are keen to find new ways to shape important stories about the environment, climate, energy and politics. We seek a strong writer, editor and headline writer who can package our stories for maximum appeal and impact.

This is a leadership role with management and oversight responsibilities within a unionized workplace. This position is excluded from the bargaining unit.

The successful applicant will manage staff Monday through Friday between 12pm and 8pm Eastern Time / 9am and 5pm Pacific Time. The working hours are non-negotiable.

Daily responsibilities

  • Manage reporters in the afternoons
  • Supervise evening copy/newsletters
  • Focus on writing compelling headlines
  • Manage project budgets
  • Negotiate freelance contractor agreements
  • Manage editorial calendar, ensuring deadlines are met and quality is maintained
  • Help design and implement CNO’s project work
  • Fill in for EIC as required during vacations and sick days
  • Find compelling visuals, improve photography photo editing tools
  • Package stories for social media
  • Provide vacation relief for editors and newsletter editor
  • Recruit, hire and manage journalists and editors

Basic requirements

  • Minimum 7 years of experience in journalism
  • Strong understanding of politics, climate change and disinformation
  • Excellent editorial skills with a track record of impactful storytelling
  • Experience in a leadership or management role
  • Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively and manage deadlines
  • Ace headline, story packaging and copy editing skills
  • Able to navigate a fast-paced work environment with flexibility, professionalism, and kindness

What we offer

  • Sun Life extended health package
  • Employer matching RSP
  • Benefits including one month of vacation, personal and sick days and equipment budget
  • Career development, mentorship and opportunity over time to take on a larger leadership role in the organization
  • Conference and training support
  • Subscriptions to other news sources and industry magazines

How to apply — Please read carefully

Upload your resume, a cover letter and three writing samples to the Bamboo Portal link

Requirements before applying: read Canada's National Observer and explore the site. Sign up for our newsletters. It costs $1 to subscribe for a month — subscribe and see how things work. Your cover letter should demonstrate your research abilities, your writing voice, and your understanding of the company. Sign up for Civic Searchlight and use it so you understand this as well. If you haven’t done a serious deep dive into what we do, and how we do it, you aren’t ready to apply.

A note on AI: Do not send us an AI-generated CV and cover letter. We want to hear your voice and see your work experience laid out clearly. In your cover letter, make it clear why you'd want to work for Canada's National Observer.

This post will remain open until we find the right candidate, but we hope to have someone in place by October.

Canada's National Observer is committed to building a team that reflects the country we cover. About Us

Abacus Insights is transforming how data works for health plans. Our mission is simple: make healthcare data usable, so the people responsible for care and cost decisions can act faster, with confidence.

We help health plans break down data silos to create a single, trusted data foundation. That foundation powers better decisions—so plans can improve outcomes, reduce waste, and deliver better experiences for members and providers alike. Backed by $100M from top investors, we’re tackling big challenges in an industry that’s ready for change. Our platform enables GenAI use cases by delivering clean, connected, and reliable healthcare data to support automation, prioritization, and decision workflows—and it’s why we are leading the way.

Our innovation begins with people. We are bold, curious, and collaborative—because the best ideas come from working together. We embrace the thoughtful use of AI and automation to drive innovation and efficiency, and we look for individuals who are curious and adaptable—those excited to leverage emerging technologies to enhance how we work—while keeping human insight, connection, and our clients at the center of every decision.

Ready to make an impact? Join us and let’s build the future together.

About the Role

Abacus Insights is at the forefront of transforming how health plans harness their data, and we are looking for a driven project leader to join our Implementation Program Management Office and help us deliver on that mission. You will lead complex, high-visibility IT projects across the US healthcare payer space, working at the intersection of cutting-edge cloud technology and one of the most consequential industries in the country.

You will own end-to-end delivery across a portfolio of client implementations, partnering with technical, clinical, and client-facing teams to solve hard problems and move fast without sacrificing quality. The work is real, the stakes are high, and the impact is visible.

For the right person, this role is also a launching pad — offering a clear path into senior PMO leadership, deep exposure to modern cloud-based data infrastructure, and a front-row seat to the future of healthcare technology at a company that is growing quickly and building something that lasts.

Your day to day

  • Manage end-to-end delivery of multiple large-scale projects or multiple smaller projects, ensuring timelines, scope, and quality are consistently achieved
  • Coordinate closely with Client Delivery Managers to understand client requirements and translate them into delivery objectives, milestones, dependencies, and sequencing that support an accurate and effective project schedule.
  • Apply industry standard project management practices across Schedule Management, Risk Management, Communications Management, and Stakeholder Engagement to improve delivery predictability, transparency, and cross-functional accountability.
  • Partner closely with cross-functional technical teams and client teams to understand delivery needs, constraints, and dependencies, then translate those inputs into clear business-facing decisions, status updates, mitigation plans, and executive-level project health reporting.
  • Own integrated project schedule management, including work plan development, milestone tracking, dependency management, critical path visibility, variance reporting, and alignment to client requirements.
  • Maintain disciplined risk and issue management practices, including RAID log ownership, proactive risk identification, mitigation planning, escalation path management, and follow-through on issue resolution.
  • Conduct detailed resource planning and capacity management to support realistic delivery commitments and schedule execution.
  • Facilitate regular status meetings to maintain project health visibility, confirm decisions and next steps, and ensure timely escalation of risks, issues, and dependencies.

What you bring to the team

  • Delivery Leadership: 10+ years leading technically complex IT projects and programs, with 8+ years in a dedicated Project Manager role and a consistent track record of on-time, high-quality delivery.
  • End-to-End Project Governance: Proven ability to drive projects through the full lifecycle — initiation through handover — using standard PMO artifacts including Project Charter, RAID, RACI, schedules, and status reporting.
  • Healthcare & Client Delivery: Demonstrated experience delivering healthcare IT implementations, with payer-side experience strongly preferred. Able to set and hold clear client expectations around scope, timelines, dependencies, and outcomes.
  • Agile & Hybrid Delivery: Comfortable managing in hybrid environments that combine Agile team execution with milestone-based planning, schedule governance, and structured stakeholder reporting.
  • Technical Acumen: Experience coordinating across software development, data engineering, system integration, QA, and architecture functions — with enough technical fluency to make informed calls on risks and trade-offs.
  • Risk & Dependency Management: Strong instincts for proactively identifying, tracking, and escalating risks, issues, and cross-functional dependencies. No surprises to stakeholders.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills across client, leadership, and cross-functional audiences. Comfortable defending a position, driving decisions, and holding team members accountable.
  • Tools & AI Enablement: Hands-on experience with Smartsheet, Jira, and AI agentic tools to support schedule management, backlog coordination, RAID tracking, and stakeholder reporting.

What we would like to see, but not required

  • US Healthcare implementation experience, with direct exposure to healthcare payer environments, enabling faster onboarding and effective client engagement within Abacus’ payer‑focused delivery model
  • Experience working for or with a US Medicaid payer.
  • Formal project management certification such as PMP® or PRINCE2®, demonstrating strong grounding in structured delivery governance, planning, and control
  • Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or equivalent Agile certification, supporting effective collaboration with Product, Engineering, and QA teams in Agile or hybrid delivery models

Compensation: Compensation for this role is based on experience, skills, and location, and includes base salary plus eligibility for performance bonuses and equity grants.

What you’ll get in return

  • Unlimited paid time off – recharge when you need it
  • Work from anywhere – flexibility to fit your life
  • Comprehensive health coverage – multiple plan options to choose from
  • Equity for every employee – share in our success
  • Growth-focused environment – your development matters here

Our Commitment as an Equal Opportunity Employer

As a mission-led technology company helping to drive better healthcare outcomes, Abacus Insights believes that the best innovation and value we can bring to our customers comes from diverse ideas, thoughts, experiences, and perspectives. jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

Recovering entrepreneur? Frustrated with bureaucracy? Want to write the roadmap, not inherit one?

We're hiring across multiple levels and verticals. The nice thing about growing 30%+ at ~$2B ARR is that we need great engineers everywhere, and we have the room to shape the role around the right person. You build like a founder. We give you the platform to do it at scale.

About the role:

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) sits at the center of hardware, software, AI, and the physical world. The platform processes 25+ trillion data points annually from IoT sensors, cameras, and connected devices across thousands of organizations, and that dataset is compounding: it grew from 4 trillion to 25+ trillion in four years. We're still early in turning that data into the products that will define how physical operations run, and we're hiring the engineers who will build what comes next.

We're approaching ~$2B ARR growing 30%+ year over year, with 96% of our largest customers on two or more products. The fastest-growing divisions at Samsara are tackling the hardest, most ambiguous problems at the company: building new products from scratch, applying AI and ML to massive real-world datasets, and shipping capabilities that change how organizations maintain equipment, manage fleets, and run day-to-day operations. Most of this work is zero-to-one, at billion-dollar scale.

We're looking for software engineers who want to define what ships next. Leveling is broad and flexible: we're hiring from Senior through Principal, across platform and product, and we're open to shaping scope around the right person's strengths and interests. That window won't stay open long.

This role is remote and open to candidates residing in the US. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world. The software you build will have real-world stakes: helping keep the lights on, getting food into grocery stores, keeping workers safe. What ships here isn't metrics on a dashboard. It shows up on the loading dock, the job site, and the dispatch floor.
  • You want to build, not maintain. Samsara is in full growth mode. We're building new systems from scratch, not babysitting old ones. You'd own entire problem spaces end to end, with the autonomy to set direction from day one.
  • You want to work where AI meets the physical world. Samsara has spent a decade building the largest proprietary dataset for physical operations. More connected assets generate more data, more data trains better models, better models drive more value, and more value wins more assets. The market and the opportunity here are what set us apart, not just the models.
  • You believe customers are more than a number. Samsara engineers have a rare closeness to end users. You'll participate in customer interviews, collaborate with product managers and customer success, and use that context to build products that solve real problems operators face every day.
  • You have the curiosity and drive to figure it out. We're looking for people who take pride in their work and get things done at all costs. The engineers who thrive here don't wait to be told what to build. They define it, ship it, and own the outcome. The rate-limiting step on our teams isn't tooling or process. It's ambition.

In this role, you will:

jobs.description:
Senior Product Manager - Servicing (US Remote)

Why this Role Matters:

The Senior Product Manager - Servicing will own the product experience across Greenbox Capital’s servicing ecosystem, including both the tools used by internal team members and the experiences used by our customers.

This role is responsible for understanding business problems, customer needs, operational workflows, and team-member pain points, then translating those insights into scalable product solutions that improve efficiency, usability, and business outcomes.

You will serve as the architect of business impact, defining the problems we should solve, shaping the future-state experience, establishing requirements and success measures, and partnering closely with Technology to bring those solutions to life.

Salesforce is currently a key internal platform supporting servicing and may expand into additional areas of the business over time. While Salesforce experience is valuable, this is not a Salesforce administrator or technical architecture role. We are looking for a strong product leader who knows how to solve business problems from both the customer and team-member perspective.

In addition to owning the servicing experience, this role will support other strategic initiatives across the company through Greenbox Capital’s product pod structure.

This role reports to the Chief Operating Officer and works closely with Technology, Operations, Underwriting, Risk, Sales, Data, and other business teams.

What Success Looks Like:

Here’s how your time might break down (actual time can shift depending on business needs):

  • Servicing Product & Experience Ownership - Owning the roadmap and experience across customer-facing servicing capabilities and internal team-member tools
  • Product Discovery & Delivery - Identifying the right problems to solve and moving initiatives from discovery through development, launch, and iteration
  • Business Process & Workflow Optimization - Redesigning workflows, reducing friction, and identifying opportunities to simplify, automate, or improve how work gets done
  • Cross-Functional Product Leadership - Partnering across Product, Technology, Operations, Underwriting, Risk, Sales, and Data to solve high-priority business problems
  • Product Adoption & Business Impact - Ensuring new capabilities are adopted, used effectively, and produce measurable improvements in customer and business outcomes

How you’ll be measured:

Servicing Product & Experience Ownership:

  • Own and evolve the product roadmap for Greenbox Capital’s servicing experience
  • Develop a deep understanding of customer journeys, team-member workflows, operational challenges, and business needs
  • Define product priorities based on customer value, operational impact, business outcomes, effort, and strategic importance
  • Design future-state experiences and workflows that simplify processes and improve outcomes
  • Ensure internal tools and customer-facing experiences work cohesively across the servicing lifecycle

Product Discovery & Delivery:

  • Lead product initiatives from problem identification and discovery through launch and iteration
  • Conduct discovery with customers, team members, and business stakeholders to understand root problems before defining solutions
  • Translate complex business needs into clear product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and measures of success
  • Maintain backlog clarity and establish thoughtful prioritization across competing initiatives
  • Partner closely with Technology throughout development, QA, release readiness, and implementation
  • Evaluate product performance after launch and drive continuous improvement based on data and user feedback

Business Process & Workflow Optimization:

  • Identify friction, unnecessary complexity, manual work, and breakdowns within servicing and operational workflows
  • Determine when processes should be redesigned, simplified, automated, or enabled through technology
  • Design scalable future-state workflows in partnership with business and Technology stakeholders
  • Identify opportunities to improve or expand the use of Salesforce and other platforms
  • Ensure new solutions integrate effectively with existing systems, data, and operational processes
  • Balance immediate business needs with longer-term scalability

Cross-Functional Product Leadership:

  • Partner with Operations, Underwriting, Risk, Sales, Technology, Data, and other teams to solve priority business problems
  • Support strategic initiatives outside the core servicing roadmap through Greenbox Capital’s product pod structure
  • Create alignment around problem definition, requirements, priorities, trade-offs, and success measures
  • Communicate product direction and decisions clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Challenge assumptions and help teams distinguish between symptoms, root causes, and the right solution

Product Adoption & Business Impact:

  • Define clear success measures for major product initiatives
  • Monitor adoption, workflow utilization, customer experience, operational performance, and relevant business outcomes
  • Partner with stakeholders on UAT, training, documentation, release communication, and change adoption
  • Identify where released capabilities are not producing the intended outcomes and determine what needs to change
  • Continuously improve the product based on user behavior, feedback, operational data, and business performance

You’re a Strong Fit if You:

  • Think about product through the lens of the customer, the team member, and the business outcome
  • Naturally seek to understand the problem before jumping to a solution
  • Can take messy, ambiguous business challenges and turn them into structured product opportunities
  • Understand how operational workflows, technology, data, and customer experience intersect
  • Know how to distinguish between improving an existing process and designing a better future-state process
  • Can translate business needs into clear requirements that Technology teams can execute
  • Are comfortable challenging assumptions and asking why a process exists before automating it
  • Balance strategic product thinking with hands-on execution
  • Prioritize based on impact rather than simply responding to the loudest stakeholder
  • Communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Use data, user feedback, and business context to make product decisions
  • Are comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where priorities and business needs evolve
  • Demonstrate strong ownership and accountability from problem identification through business outcome
  • Adapt well in a distributed team environment and collaborate effectively across functions

What You’ve Done Before:

  • Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in Business, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field
  • Minimum 5 years of product management experience delivering complex software or technology-enabled products
  • Demonstrated experience translating customer, user, and business problems into scalable product solutions
  • Experience leading product initiatives through discovery, requirements definition, prioritization, development, launch, and iteration
  • Experience working closely with engineering or Technology teams throughout the product lifecycle
  • Experience improving operational workflows, business systems, or internal tools
  • Experience using data and customer or user feedback to inform product decisions
  • Experience managing competing priorities and maintaining a clear product backlog or roadmap
  • Experience working with Salesforce as a product or business platform preferred
  • Experience building products that serve both internal users and external customers preferred
  • Experience in fintech, lending, servicing, payments, alternative finance, or another operationally complex environment preferred
  • Experience working within cross-functional product pods or similar delivery models preferred

Tools and Expertise You’ll Bring:

  • Product strategy and roadmap development
  • Product discovery and problem definition
  • Customer journey and user workflow analysis
  • Business process and future-state workflow design
  • Product requirements and user story development
  • Backlog management and prioritization
  • Agile or Scrum product development methodologies
  • Internal tools and customer-facing product experiences
  • Salesforce-based product environments
  • Workflow automation and operational systems design
  • Product analytics and data-informed decision-making
  • UAT, release readiness, and product adoption
  • Analytics platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, Sigma, Looker, or Databricks
  • SDLC and product management tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira, Linear, or Shortcut
  • Vendor, platform, and integration management

What to Expect from Our Interview Process

We believe in a respectful, efficient, and transparent hiring experience. Here’s what you can expect (subject to changes depending on role):

Step 1: Initial Phone Screen

Step 2: Recruiter Interview

Step 3: Interview with Chief Operating Officer

Step 4: Product / Business Working Session

Step 5: Cross-Functional Leadership Interviews

Step 6: References, Offer & Background Check

What's In It For You:

💸 Competitive Pay - We know your worth and we pay accordingly.

🌴 Flexible PTO - Work hard, rest well. Take the time you need to recharge.

🏡 Remote - Fully remote within the U.S., working Eastern Time hours to keep everyone aligned.

🩺 Full Benefits Package - Health, dental, vision, 401K with employer match

🧠 Smart, Supportive Teammates - Collaborate with sharp minds who are kind, driven and uphold our core values: Wear Green First, Pull the Thread, Move the Needle, Courage Over Comfort, Think Bold, Win Together, and Own the Outcome

jobs.excerpt: Summary of Job Role and ResponsibilitiesThe ideal Senior team member will provide leadership in many areas but specific to this position is the ability to support the analysis of data center infrastructure as part of our strategy development projects.
jobs.description:
Summary of Job Role and Responsibilities

The ideal Senior team member will provide leadership in many areas but specific to this position is the ability to support the analysis of data center infrastructure as part of our strategy development projects. The skill sets are broken into 4 categories, Electrical, Mechanical, Operations, and Master Planning. The successful candidate must have these skills for the accurate completion of various data center “due diligence” tasks as part of an overall team conducting a data center strategy analysis for our client.

Electrical

  • Demonstrated expertise in interpreting electrical one-line diagrams and evaluating mission-critical electrical distribution systems, including utility service, switchgear, UPS, generators, transfer switches, PDUs, transformers, and grounding systems.
  • Strong understanding of electrical redundancy concepts (N, N+1, 2N, etc.), reliability principles, load calculations, power capacity, and identifying single points of failure with practical risk mitigation strategies.
  • Ability to assess the condition, operation, and maintenance effectiveness of critical power infrastructure, including UPS systems, battery systems, standby power, electrical distribution equipment, and associated controls.
  • Experience collecting, analyzing, and interpreting operational data from electrical infrastructure to evaluate system performance, reliability, energy efficiency, and compliance with industry best practices.
  • Working knowledge of the National Electrical Code (NEC), mission-critical facility design standards, and the ability to safely perform work in energized or critical infrastructure environments.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and computer skills, with the ability to serve as a trusted subject matter expert while preparing technical reports and using Microsoft Office applications.

Mechanical

  • Interpret mechanical one-line drawings and evaluate HVAC infrastructure in mission-critical facilities, from central cooling plants through CRAC/CRAH systems, while understanding redundancy concepts and calculating system load capacity.
  • Assess the condition, operation, and maintenance of mechanical infrastructure including chillers, cooling towers, heat rejection systems, pumps, valves, piping, thermal storage, and associated controls and instrumentation.
  • Analyze mechanical system designs to identify components, single points of failure, reliability risks, and energy optimization opportunities, providing practical recommendations to improve resilience, maintainability, and efficiency.
  • Collect, interpret, and analyze operational data from mechanical equipment and perform engineering calculations related to cooling capacity, power, kVA, power factor, and energy performance.
  • Apply industry best practices for mission-critical mechanical systems, including redundancy classifications, reliability principles (MTBF, MTTR, availability, maintainability), and safe work practices while effectively using Microsoft Office applications.
  • Serve as a confident, customer-facing mechanical subject matter expert, communicating technical findings and recommendations clearly while following written and verbal instructions.

Operations

  • Develop maintenance staffing plans and define the technical skill requirements needed to support mission-critical facility operations.
  • Operate and evaluate Building Monitoring and Control Systems (BMS/BAS) supporting critical mechanical and electrical infrastructure.
  • Assess the condition, maintenance practices, and documentation of mission-critical infrastructure, including raised floor environments, fire detection and suppression systems, and critical equipment records.
  • Evaluate operational processes including maintenance management, change management, and security systems to ensure reliability, compliance, and best practices.
  • Identify single points of failure, assess infrastructure reliability risks, and develop practical, cost-effective mitigation recommendations to improve data center availability.
  • Demonstrate comprehensive knowledge of mission-critical systems including Emergency Power Off (EPO), VESDA, FM-200, Ansul, sprinkler and pre-action systems, as well as physical security technologies such as card access, video surveillance, biometric access, and perimeter protection.

Conceptual Master Planning

  • Be able to evaluate the overall facility and provide input to such in the planning sessions and workshops
  • Working with Engineering/Design colleagues, assist in the development of conceptual designs for infrastructure expansion and/or capacity changes.
  • Possess a complete understanding redundancy requirements and Tier levels
  • Ability to evaluate the overall critical loading requirements for data center “greenfield” options
  • Ability to provide ROM (Rough Order of Magnitude) estimates (+/- 30%) for recommendations
  • Ability to present findings and interact with customers at all levels.

Other Skills and Knowledge

The Senior Data Center Consultant will demonstrate the following required abilities: • Managing and participating in the delivery of major projects – the candidate is expected to act as the client partner and project executive for all projects they develop. This will position the candidate to manage the project, its quality, and the client as a portfolio over time. The candidate will participate in delivery and will need to learn the use of the group’s analytic tools and support that need as required. The candidate will also manage the project to the forecast financial measures.

Presentation and Writing Skills: The candidate will need to communicate professionally, effectively, and persuasively in verbal and written form to client CIO/CFO/COO’s and other senior positions. In addition to client focused work, the candidate is expected to participate as an industry expert in symposiums, professional journals, and webinars.

Team-members generally work from their home office and travel when required. Travel can average 25%-50%, but there might be times when sustained travel over short periods of time are required, particularly when supporting our global projects.

It is desirable that the successful candidate have one or more of the following advanced requirements:

  • Applicable data center professional certifications
  • 10 Years + data center operational experience in privately owned or colocation facilities
  • BA/BS from an accredited College/University. Engineering or Computer Science degree is a plus.
  • Ability to pass a background check prior to offer letter
  • Hold a U.S. passport and travel internationally

Work at the heart of sustainable change

Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. We believe sustainable change should create a thriving world for both nature and people. Our culture is grounded in openness, curiosity, responsibility, and respect for diverse perspectives.

Ready to join us?

If you are ready to bring your project leadership, technical judgment, and client management skills to a business focused on sustainable energy solutions, we invite you to apply.

Please submit your application and include your CV and any other relevant documents.

Ramboll in the Americas

Founded in Denmark, Ramboll is a foundation-owned people company. Ramboll has thousands of experts working across more than 70 offices in the Americas, delivering innovative solutions within Environment & Health, Water, Energy, and Planning & Urban Design. We invite you to contribute to a sustainable future working in an open, collaborative, and empowering company. Combining local experience with global knowledge, we together shape the societies of tomorrow.

Salary Transparency

At Ramboll, we are committed to fair and transparent compensation practices that support our people and our purpose of creating sustainable societies. The anticipated base salary range for this position is $125,000 to $155,000 per year. This range reflects the compensation we reasonably expect to offer at the time of posting. Actual compensation will vary based on factors such as location, skills, experience, education, and internal equity. Because we operate across multiple U.S. markets, pay may differ depending on the cost of labor in specific locations. In addition to base salary, this position may be eligible for bonus, overtime or other forms of compensation and we offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports well-being, professional development, and work-life balance. Our recruiters are happy to share more about the specific salary range and total rewards package applicable to your location during the hiring process.

Where People Flourish

Our mission is to create sustainable societies where people and nature flourish. This means that a culture of inclusion is embedded in everything we do. Our people bring diverse backgrounds and experiences to the company, enabling us to deliver innovative and forward-thinking solutions to our clients. We also know how important it is to achieve the right balance of where, when, and how much you work. At Ramboll, we offer flexibility as part of our positive and inclusive approach to work. Ramboll wants to ensure opportunities are accessible to candidates with disabilities. So, please let us know if there are any changes we could make to the application process to make it more comfortable for you. You can contact us at with such requests.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Position: Senior Data Center Consultant

EYP Mission Critical Facilities, part of Ramboll Americas Engineering, is an innovator and a market leader in sustainable Data Center Consulting & Strategy, Design, and Commissioning with a 25-year history of excellence in the industry. Numerous Fortune 500 companies, top tier universities, and global data center providers/investors, rely on EYP MCF to provide responsive solutions to today’s complex data center challenges. The Consulting groups core focus is to provide data center strategy analysis with the expertise to address the clients forward mission goals inclusive of their IT and Network architecture. The end goal is to develop a data center sourcing solution for our clients to use their existing facilities, colocation services, cloud services, or build new facilities. This includes developing a new data center topology, reliability and redundancy needs, and associated financial analysis for decision support requirements. The group also supports a wide range of data center assessment projects for investors looking to acquire data centers or develop them. Our growing team depends on motivated professionals with a flexible skill set and the ability to provide often unique, critical thinking to address the ever-changing landscape of data center design and operations.

You'll combine program leadership, operational judgment, and strong cross-functional relationships to ensure our product organization operates with clarity, consistency, and speed.

This is a role for someone who loves building leverage. Someone who sees operations not as administration, but as product design applied to how teams work.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own Mercury's Product Launch Program: Own Mercury's launch operating model, ensuring launches move through review with clear ownership, strong cross-functional coordination, and high quality. Continuously improve launch workflows, review processes, and retrospectives as Mercury scales.
  • Lead the New Grad PM Rotational Program: Own Mercury's rotational program for early-career Product Managers. Coordinate rotations, partner with managers and leadership, and evolve the program to deliver an exceptional development experience.

  • Drive Product Culture programming: Design and operate programs that strengthen Mercury's product culture, from internal rituals to external events and thought leadership. Partner across Product, Design, Communications, Recruiting, and People to create experiences that scale with the organization.
  • Drive Cross-Functional Programs: Lead complex, cross-functional initiatives across Product, Engineering, Design, Communications, Recruiting, and People. Create clarity, build alignment, and keep programs moving with momentum.

The ideal candidate for the role has:

  • A track record of owning cross-functional programs from concept through execution, balancing strategic thinking with exceptional operational follow-through.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent initiatives while maintaining a consistently high bar for quality.
  • A product mindset. You approach internal operations the same way great product teams approach customer products—understanding user needs, measuring outcomes, iterating quickly, and continuously improving the experience.
  • A bias toward action paired with sound judgment. You know when speed matters, when quality matters, and how to balance both in a fast-moving environment.

  • Work with technical staff to improve annotation tools for efficient audio workflows.

  • Native proficiency in Serbian with exposure to diverse accents, dialects, or regional variations.

  • Demonstrated ability to handle multilingual audio content, including evaluating speech accuracy, cultural vocal expressions, and contextual interpretation in spoken form.
  • Demonstrated ability to transcribe audio with high accuracy across accents and varying audio quality.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate and localize text accurately between English and Serbian, preserving meaning, tone, and cultural nuance.
  • Comfort providing high-quality voice recordings and feedback on audio samples in multiple languages.
  • Strong comprehension skills and the ability to make independent judgments on ambiguous or varied audio material, including noisy or accented speech.

Job Description:

Providing for loved ones, planning rewarding retirements, saving enough for whatever lies ahead – our policyholders count on us to be there when it matters most.
